known_failures: A single short prefix may admit an arbitrary high-degree polynomial; extrapolation and private law checks are required.
Finite-difference and low training error are not formal invariance. Switching regimes and nonuniform sampling falsify simple delta assumptions.
Six baseline variants are not trained models and cannot claim discovered recurrence laws; no standalone model performance claimed.

Oracle and future target generator live in the same readable repository: API separation is NOT tamper-proof oracle sealing. A future authorized evaluator must isolate the test process to prevent source inspection and label leakage.
Fresh unpublished seeds and withheld generations are needed before generalization or anti-memorization claims.
Checker code, identity labels and Git commits are unauthenticated. Pending independent reviewer must inspect before task closure.
No upstream champion change, model weights, GPU, network use, or auto-running service.
oracle_target_commitment_method: SHA256 UTF-8 compact sorted-key JSON array of {case_id,reference_exact} entries in oracle.cases(split) order
proof_scope: Finite reproducible 99-case CPU-only forecast/structural benchmark. Hidden-law matching plus demonstrably varying held-out truth; flat fixed-point horizon forecasts may pass accuracy but never discovery. No formal theorem, neural learning, unseen-seed generalization, authenticated identity or sealed evaluator.
